root_cause: The OoO-overlap failure is in the issue/control path rather than in commit or data forwarding: the issue queue/dispatch logic still serializes functional-unit issue, so while an older load is outstanding/waiting on external memory, no younger independent ALU instruction is accepted by execute_alu and dbg_ooo_bypass never fires. The power overrun is an implementation/power issue: large queue/ROB/rename state vectors are rewritten every cycle without write enables, and execute_alu does not isolate operands when issue is invalid. Top-level completion/debug wiring must also be checked because alu_complete_valid/rob_index and the real bypass event must reach the ROB and dbg outputs. Separately, the known rename_unit variable-row write into an unpacked 2D array hangs yosys and must be made constant-index while preserving behavior.
repair_constraints: Never rename any module, port, or file; preserve all interface contracts exactly as given for rv32i5, issue_queue, execute_alu, reorder_buffer, load_store_unit, and rename_unit.
The existing TB must remain PASS; do not change architectural results, retire PCs/instructions, halt/exit timing, or the single-cycle dbg_retire_valid behavior.
dbg_ooo_issue/dbg_ooo_bypass must be generated from real issue/completion state, at most one event per instruction/cycle; do not fabricate them with counters or PC-pattern detection.

Allow a younger independent integer ALU instruction to be selected and accepted while an older load is outstanding; verify alu_complete_valid and alu_complete_rob_index are driven and connected to the ROB, and that the issue queue does not globally stall ALU issue on load_complete_valid.

Add per-entry write enables / operand isolation for large vector state instead of unconditional per-cycle full-vector rewrites; ALU operands must be isolated when issue_valid is low, without changing functional behavior.

In rename_unit, fix the yosys hang by row-decoding writes so every write into an unpacked 2D array has a constant row index; audit all variable-index writes into ckpt_map_nxt and related 2D arrays, but do not modify the already-correct FIFO-to-bitmap refactor or any port/module names.
